rules: Secrets may exist only in GitHub Actions Secrets or equivalent secret stores.
Secret values must never be printed, committed, persisted to Drive, included in artifacts, or copied into handoffs.
Runtime code may only test whether the selected provider secret is present; it must not serialize the value.
Missing authentication must fail closed for model-dependent tasks, but does not block relay transport self-tests that do not call a model.
Provider selection may be configured by a non-secret repository variable named LCR_MODEL_PROVIDER.
